help.title: Help — Feature guide
help.subtitle: Find here an explanation of all the features of every JENNY page.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Overview of JENNY and the list of recently added features.

themes.title: Tool overview
features: Overview of JENNY and its mission: optimize your commercial performance.
Presentation of the key principles: organize, plan, perform.

themes.title: Recent features
features: "Recently added features" section: follow the latest site updates.
The list is updated on every significant site update.

pages.title: Sites
pages.description: Management of industrial sites and groups, with an interactive map and AI-assisted visit planning.

themes.title: Site list and search
features: Site list with search by name, group or country and matching site counter.
Status colors: Not visited, Visited, Visited 18+ months ago, To visit, Closed.
Contact count per site and last visit history.

themes.title: Groups and site creation
features: Group creation and editing; renaming a group is propagated to associated sites and contacts.
Site creation: name, group, domain, status color, address (automatic lookup), country and observations.
Renaming a site is automatically propagated to its contacts.

themes.title: AI visit mode
features: Click the pins of the sites to visit on the map, then generate an optimized trip (train preferred, plane if needed, rental car on site).
Save the generated trip as a travel project and find it in the Visit page.

pages.title: Site detail
pages.description: Full site sheet: information, visit history and associated contacts.

themes.title: Site information
features: Editing of information: name, group, domain, color, country, address, observations, last visit date.
Visit history of the site.

themes.title: Site contacts
features: Site contact list with function, emails, phone numbers and active/inactive status.
Adding a contact directly from the site sheet.
One-click copy of all active contact emails of the site.

pages.title: Contacts
pages.description: Complete management of your contact directory.

themes.title: Contact list and search
features: Contact list with search and matching contact counter.
"Active only" filter and active/inactive status per contact.

themes.title: Adding and editing a contact
features: Fields: last name, first name, function, gender, group, site, phones (landline and mobile), language, email and observations.
Deactivating a contact (e.g. leaving the company) without deleting it.

themes.title: AI mode (business card)
features: Import a business card photo to pre-fill the fields automatically (including gender and language).
Duplicate check before saving.

pages.title: Emails
pages.description: Quick extraction of your contacts' emails based on your zones.

themes.title: Filters and retrieval
features: Email retrieval filtered by country and language.
"Active only" filter enabled by default, country/language selection and select/deselect all.
Full loading of contacts, even beyond 1000 rows.

themes.title: Copying emails
features: Copy of retrieved emails to the clipboard in one click.
Display of the number of duplicates ignored during retrieval.

pages.title: Prospecting
pages.description: Prospecting suggestions from the weekly AI scan (ball mills / rotary kilns).

themes.title: Suggestion list
features: List of site and group suggestions with search and "Pending only" filter.
Display in batches of 50 suggestions, full loading beyond 1000 rows.
"Information search / commercial watch" section on existing sites (AI feature coming soon).

themes.title: Sorting suggestions
features: Sorting by clicking on column titles (ascending/descending).
Sorting by relevance rate or by creation date.

themes.title: Handling a suggestion
features: Open the source, delete, or analyze to create the site.
Statuses: Approved / Refused / Already in database.

pages.title: Visit
pages.description: Management of your client travel projects created from the Sites page AI visit mode.

themes.title: Travel projects
features: List of your trips with status (Draft, Planned, Done), visited countries and total mileage.
Deleting a travel project.
Dynamic trip map and PDF export of the roadbook (Jenny branding, map included).

themes.title: Travel preferences
features: Origin city, preferred departure stations and airports (free entry worldwide).
Standard meeting duration or customized per site.

themes.title: Trip steps
features: Add and rename steps, visit date and time (15-minute steps).
Reordering of client visits: days and times are fully rescheduled automatically, transfers adapted.

themes.title: Credentials
features: Email change (with email confirmation) and password change.
Password reset in case you forget it.

themes.title: Preferences and information
features: Preferred language (French / English) applied to the whole site.
Personal information and list of countries assigned to you (zones).

pages.title: Zone management (admin)
pages.description: Admin-only page to assign countries to users.

themes.title: Zone assignment
features: User selection and assignment of their countries (zones of action).
Select all / deselect all, then save.
Dynamic map of assigned zones.

themes.title: Impact of zones
features: These zones determine which contacts and emails each user can see in the Emails and Contacts pages.

themes.title: Sign in and sign out
features: Sign in with your email and password.
Log out from the "My account" menu.

themes.title: Forgotten password
features: Password reset via the "forgotten password" link.
